name: Pour House @ Jefferson
description: Pour House Saloon is a lively karaoke venue known for its welcoming atmosphere and strong sense of community. It offers a vibrant sound system, a diverse song library, and regular live music nights. The staff is praised for their friendliness and attentiveness, creating a fun and inclusive environment. With food, drinks, and alcohol served, it’s a perfect spot for both casual nights out and private celebrations. The venue maintains a clean, well-kept space with ample parking, making it accessible and convenient for all guests. Whether you're here for open mic nights or karaoke competitions, Pour House Saloon provides an energetic and memorable experience that keeps locals and visitors coming back.
